reason: This is primarily an AI orchestration plugin for the DSH ecosystem: a proactive scheduler/agent layer that observes signals, plans execution, runs multi-model task chains, and evolves strategy over time. Conservatively, user-facing capabilities center on workflow automation and host-aware agent scheduling (including safety governance). Moderately higher-risk due to credential handling and host-tool governance capabilities; no immediate blockers evident from provided evidence.

capabilities: Autonomous scheduling/dispatch of tasks and model execution within DSH host runtime.
Host-level tool observation and governance hooks (including optional kill-switch style interruption) in shared tool pipeline.
Persistent memory and experience retrieval/feedback used for planning and execution decisions.
API key ingestion from host/env/config with key-rotation and fallback behavior.
Distributed operational features (consensus/sync/hot-reload) exposed as plugin services.

reasons.code: Core purpose is an autonomous scheduler/orchestrator that can issue and govern actions without direct user prompts.
Plugin exports host-integration tools and declares DSH plugin bundle/patch wiring, indicating it runs inside and influences host workflow.
Feature set includes host tool pre-execute/observability, autonomy loop, safety governor, and multi-key credential handling.
Repository structure includes autonomy loop, safety governor, memory, consensus, sync, and policy/sandbox/hot-reload components, confirming operational scope.
